doc.title: Harold Ousley interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001

title: Interview opening with Monk Rowe
summary: Rowe introduces the interview in New York and thanks Ousley for coming; they mention meeting in the lobby the night before.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in New York City for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m quite pleased to have Harold Ousley with me this morning. Thank you for getting up so early.
It’s a pleasure to be here.
We had a kind of fortuitous meeting in the lobby last night to make this happen.
Yeah. So many wonderful things going on here.
Yeah. You’ve had quite a varied career in your life. And when you grew up in Chicago, the music at that time, you kind of grew up right in the midst of the swing and hot jazz era.
